title: Bakery pickup change
brief:
You are handling weekend orders at a bakery. Write a text message to the customer who ordered two dozen assorted rolls for a Saturday book club breakfast. Their confirmed pickup time was 8 a.m. The rolls will now be ready at 8:30 a.m., and the customer previously said the meeting starts at 9. As an alternative, you can have two dozen plain rolls ready at 8 for the same price. Ask which option works and say how long you can hold the original order on Saturday.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

b17cef6b5c26e7bf.text: Hi! I’m sorry for the change to your Saturday pickup. Your two dozen assorted rolls will be ready at 8:30 a.m., half an hour later than we confirmed. I know your book club starts at 9, so if you’d like to keep your 8 a.m. pickup, we can have two dozen plain rolls ready then for the same price. Which works better for you? If you choose the assorted rolls, we can hold them for you until noon on Saturday.

5f4275890df2a562.text: Hi! A quick update on your Saturday book club order. Your two dozen assorted rolls will be ready at 8:30 a.m. instead of the confirmed 8 a.m. pickup. Since your meeting starts at 9, we can have two dozen plain rolls ready at 8 a.m. for the same price if that works better. If you’d like to keep your assorted rolls, we can hold them until noon on Saturday. Which option works best for you?
